request.title: How to pay creators who promote the app?
request.why: It sets the commercial terms with external partners.

options.label: Revenue share per paid install
options.detail: $1.50 per paid install, settled at purchase time, so it is hard to game.

request.rec_reason: Pays only for results and settles immediately.

response.conditions: Use a unique code per creator, and pay monthly with a 14-day refund window deducted.

ack.note: Terms drafted with per-creator codes and monthly payout; draft is attached to the next review item.
